segments.he: רבינו ז"ל אמר שרוחניות הקשור בגשמיות אל ירבו בזה (למשל אפי' אכילה שלמצות או שאר מצות שיש הנאה בגשמיות אל ירבו מזה):
segments.en: Moharan'as would sit at the third Shabbos meal and say Torah to our fellowship with arousal — continuing until several hours into the night. And Yosil Beriz [who would beat himself with a birch-broom in the steam bath] — the father of Reb Moshe of Breslov — would enter after Ma'ariv with his pipe and sit comfortably, smoking his pipe with a calm and clear mind, and listening to Moharan'as's Torah at the third meal. And Moharan'as would say that he envied him [for the tranquility and comfort of his mind] — yet nonetheless did not want his mind: "Er iz im mekane zayn moykh iz im ruyik — nor viln mayn hobn zayn moykh vil er nit." [He envies him that his mind is calm — but to have his mind — that he does not want.]
